item.title: Election Law Violation, Seongnam FC, Gyeonggi Province Corporate Cards… Moving to Overturn All Cases Related to Lee (선거법 위반, 성남FC, 경기도 법카… 李 관련 모든 사건 뒤집기 나서)
item.description:
According to the special counsel bill for "Investigating the Truth Behind Yoon Suk Yeol's Politicized Prosecution's Fabricated Indictments," proposed by the Democratic Party on the 30th, the special counsel will have the authority to decide whether to maintain prosecution for 12 cases, including the Daejang-dong and Ssangbangwool remittance to North Korea allegations. The bill includes a provision stating, "The special counsel may request the transfer of cases under investigation that are currently being prosecuted by prosecutors and may decide whether to maintain prosecution for the transferred cases." Although the term "withdrawal of indictment" is not explicitly used, the fact that the special counsel can take over even cases undergoing trial and decide on maintaining prosecution opens the door to withdrawing indictments. <<> Legal circles have expressed concerns, stating, "Under this special counsel bill, initiated mainly by Democratic Party lawmakers who previously served as defense attorneys for President Lee Jae-myung-related cases, President Lee would appoint the special counsel, who would then decide whether to withdraw the indictment in President Lee's cases." Strong allegations of unconstitutionality are also being raised in legal circles. <<> The Democratic Party had previously explained the push for the special counsel bill as a follow-up measure to the "Parliamentary Investigation into Suspicious Cases of Fabricated Indictments by the Yoon Suk Yeol Administration's Politicized Prosecution." However, the bill submitted on that day includes cases related to President Lee that were not part of the parliamentary investigation. <<> Previously, the special committee for the "Parliamentary Investigation into Fabricated Indictments" had targeted seven cases: the Daejang-dong case, the Wirye New Town case, the bribery case involving former Deputy Director of the Democratic Research Institute Kim Yong, the Ssangbangwool remittance to North Korea case, the West Sea patrol shooting case, the Moon Jae-in administration's statistics manipulation case, and the defamation case against former President Yoon Suk Yeol involving false reports. The special counsel bill adds five more cases involving President Lee: the Seongnam FC illegal sponsorship case, the corporate card misuse case during his tenure as Gyeonggi Province Governor, the witness perjury solicitation case, the Baekhyeon-dong case, and the Public Official Election Act violation case. President Lee was facing five trials before they were suspended due to the presidential election, meaning all cases related to him are now included. <<> According to the bill, the special counsel can investigate not only cases arising from prosecutorial abuse of power during the investigation of these 12 cases but also cases already indicted by prosecutors and under trial. Under current criminal procedure law, cases in the first trial can have their indictments withdrawn. This applies to President Lee's cases involving remittance to North Korea, Daejang-dong, Wirye, Baekhyeon-dong, Seongnam FC, and the alleged misuse of Gyeonggi Province corporate cards. <<> Among President Lee's cases, the witness perjury solicitation case, which was acquitted in the first trial and suspended in the second trial, and the Public Official Election Act violation case, which was remanded to the lower court by the Supreme Court with a guilty ruling, cannot be subject to indictment withdrawal under current law, according to the Democratic Party's explanation. However, in the witness perjury solicitation case, the special counsel could withdraw the appeal. For the Public Official Election Act case, where the Supreme Court's full bench remanded it for a guilty ruling, the special counsel may not be able to overturn the conclusion but could investigate the prosecution team at the time on suspicion of "fabricated indictment." A current senior prosecutor said, "This effectively allows all investigations and trials related to the 12 cases to be dug up under the pretext of fabricated indictments." <<> The special counsel is also the largest in scale in history. It will have 357 personnel (1 special counsel, 6 deputy special counsels, 30 dispatched prosecutors, 170 public officials, and 150 special investigators), with a maximum investigation period of 180 days. This surpasses the "insurrection special counsel" (267 personnel, 170 days) that investigated the December 3 martial law incident. The special counsel will be recommended by the Democratic Party, the People Power Party, and the Rebuilding Korea Party, each nominating one candidate, with the president making the appointment. <<> The Democratic Party plans to pass the special counsel bill at the National Assembly's plenary session as early as early May. In this case, the special counsel would be appointed and begin investigations around the June 3 local elections. Kim Hyun-jung, the Democratic Party's floor spokesperson, said, "A president should not receive special treatment, but it also goes against the spirit of the constitution for a president to have to suffer harm just because they are the president." <<> In legal circles, criticism has emerged that the special counsel bill is "highly likely unconstitutional." A lawyer and former senior prosecutor said, "If there is evidence of fabricated indictments, you can use the existing judicial system like retrials. Creating a separate procedure for a specific person by the ruling party also violates the principle of equality." <<> The People Power Party called it "Lee Jae-myung's self-pardon special counsel." Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said, "This is about 'President Lee Jae-myung' appointing a special counsel to oversee the withdrawal of the indictment for 'Defendant Lee Jae-myung.'" He added, "Violence cannot last ten years; the day will come when all who participated in Lee Jae-myung's indictment withdrawal will end up in prison." <<> The Democratic Party had stated earlier on that day that "whether to include the authority to withdraw indictments in the special counsel bill is undecided." While hardliners argued for including the authority to withdraw indictments, some within the party reportedly expressed concerns that related controversy could negatively affect the local elections. The hardliners' opinion was accepted in the final version, reportedly because lawmakers who previously served as defense attorneys for President Lee's cases led the drafting of the bill. <<> Rep. Lee Geon-tae, who drafted the initial version, is a lawyer and former prosecutor who defended Jeong Jin-sang, former Democratic Party Political Coordination Office Director and a close aide to President Lee in the Daejang-dong case, and recently organized a "Meeting to Promote the Withdrawal of Indictments in President Lee Jae-myung's Cases and Parliamentary Investigation." Rep. Kim Dong-ah, who is on the list of co-sponsors, was a defense attorney in the Daejang-dong case, and Rep. Yang Bu-nam served as head of the Democratic Party's election campaign legal support team in 2022, overseeing the response to President Lee's legal risks. A current high-ranking judge said, "If a bill is led by former defense attorneys for President Lee, and the special counsel appointed by President Lee himself decides to withdraw the indictment in President Lee's cases, who would consider it a fair decision?" <<> Meanwhile, the Democratic Party decided at a full meeting of the National Assembly's Special Committee on Parliamentary Investigation into Fabricated Indictments, which concluded its activities that day, to file complaints against 31 witnesses on charges including perjury. These include prosecutor Park Sang-yong, who refused to take a witness oath at a hearing on the Ssangbangwool remittance to North Korea allegations, and former Ssangbangwool Chairman Kim Seong-tae, who testified that he "did not drink alcohol at the salmon drinking party." The People Power Party opposed this, saying, "They are filing perjury complaints against people who gave testimony not to the taste of the Democratic Party, without any logic." (더불어민주당이 30일 발의한 ‘윤석열 정치검찰 조작기소 진상규명’ 특검법안에 따르면, 특검은 대장동·쌍방울 대북송금 의혹 등 12개 사건의 공소 유지 여부를 결정할 권한을 갖는다. 법안에는 “특검은 검사가 공소 유지 중인 수사 대상 사건의 이첩을 요구할 수 있고, 이첩받은 사건의 공소 유지 여부를 결정할 수 있다”는 조항이 담겼다. ‘공소 취소’라는 단어는 쓰지 않았지만, 특검이 재판이 진행 중인 사건까지 넘겨받아 공소 유지 여부까지 결정한다는 점에서 공소 취소로 가는 길이 열린 것이다.)

item.title: Park Sang-yong "The Ruling Party Hides Behind Special Counsel to Avoid Legal Responsibility" (박상용 “與, 법적 책임 피하려 특검 뒤에 숨어”)
item.description:
Park Sang-yong, a deputy chief prosecutor at the Incheon District Prosecutors' Office who investigated the 'Ssangbangwool North Korea remittance' case, told this newspaper in a phone interview on the 30th regarding the special counsel bill proposed by the Democratic Party, "In effect, the special counsel would take over all cases involving President Lee Jae-myung that are under investigation and prosecution, and file for dismissal of indictment or withdrawal of appeal," and "If the special counsel bill passes as is, President Lee appoints a special counsel, and that special counsel dismisses the indictment in President Lee's case, it will become a problem." <<> Regarding the reason the Democratic Party seeks to dismiss the indictment in President Lee's case through a special counsel, Prosecutor Park said, "It's because if the Minister of Justice or the Prosecutor General intervenes in dismissing the indictment in the president's case, the president could later face legal responsibility." He added, "This amounts to granting a pardon through the special counsel for cases that should be judged by the court." <<> Prosecutor Park was previously selected as a witness for the 'Manipulated Indictment Parliamentary Investigation' hearing led by the Democratic Party but refused to take the oath twice. At the time, Prosecutor Park said, "If you promise not to dismiss the indictment through the special counsel, I will take the oath immediately," but this was not accepted. Regarding this, Prosecutor Park said on this day, "In the end, my fears have become reality," and "The administration is using the special counsel as special forces to neutralize the law." <<> Prosecutor Park stated, "Granting the special counsel the authority to dismiss indictments is the starting signal for the collapse of the rule of law," and "If an actual dismissal of indictment occurs, it will become natural to mobilize the entire national system to cover up the crimes of the highest authority." He added, "Power has a tendency to keep expanding," and "If we do not show this time that 'things that cannot be done even by mobilizing the entire state power should not be done,' the next administration might attempt even more severe acts than dismissing indictments." <<> Meanwhile, the Supreme Prosecutors' Office stated in a media notice on this day regarding the special counsel bill, "While the enactment of legislation is fundamentally a matter for the legislature to decide," and "It is true that there are concerns that investigations into issues that need to be confirmed in ongoing trials could have an undue impact on the independence of the judiciary." It added, "We hope that in-depth discussions will take place during the future legislative review process to ensure that there is no improper interference in cases that have been finalized or are under trial." (‘쌍방울 대북송금’ 사건을 수사한 박상용 인천지검 부부장검사는 30일 본지 통화에서 민주당이 발의한 특검법에 대해 “사실상 특검이 수사·기소 중인 이재명 대통령의 모든 사건을 다 가져와서 공소 취소, 항소 취하하겠다는 것”이라며 “특검법이 그대로 통과돼 이 대통령이 특검을 임명하고, 그 특검이 이 대통령 사건을 공소 취소하면 문제가 될 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Lee: "Some unions only care about themselves, making excessive demands" (李 “자신들만 살겠다고 일부 노조, 과도한 요구”)
item.description:
On the 30th, a day before Labor Day, President Lee Jae-myung stated, "If organized workers make excessive or unreasonable demands just to save themselves, and end up being criticized by the public, it harms not only that specific union but also other workers." This is interpreted as a remark aimed at the Samsung Electronics union, which has threatened a general strike while demanding 45 trillion won in performance bonuses. (이재명 대통령이 노동절을 하루 앞둔 30일 “일부 조직 노동자들이 자신들만 살겠다고 과도한 요구, 부당한 요구를 해서 국민들로부터 지탄받게 되면 해당 노조뿐만 아니라 다른 노동자들에게도 피해를 입히게 된다”고 했다. 45조원의 성과급을 요구하며 총파업을 예고한 삼성전자 노조를 겨냥한 발언으로 해석된다.)

While presiding over a meeting of senior secretaries at the presidential office that day, President Lee said, "It's not about saving just myself; to create a world where all workers and all citizens can thrive together, a sense of responsibility and solidarity is also necessary." He added, "The strength of workers, who are inevitably vulnerable in terms of employment, comes from the solidarity of other workers who share the same position." (이날 청와대에서 수석보좌관 회의를 주재하며 이 대통령은 “나만 살자는 아니고 노동자 모두가, 또 국민 모두가 함께 살 수 있는 세상을 만들기 위해서 책임의식과 연대의식도 필요하겠다”며 “고용에 있어서 약자일 수밖에 없는 노동자들의 힘은 같은 입장을 가진 다른 노동자의 연대에서 나온다”고 했다.)

The Samsung Electronics union is demanding performance bonuses equivalent to 15% of operating profit, estimated at 45 trillion won, and has announced a general strike from May 21 to June 7—lasting 18 days—if their demands are not met. The amount demanded by the union exceeds last year's total R&D spending by Samsung Electronics, which was 37.7 trillion won. For domestic employees in the semiconductor sector, this would amount to nearly 600 million won per person. (삼성전자 노조는 사측에 영업이익의 15%, 45조원 규모로 예상되는 성과급을 요구하고, 요구가 관철되지 않을 시 5월 21일부터 6월 7일까지 18일간 총파업을 예고한 상태다. 노조의 요구액은 지난해 삼성전자 전체 연구개발비 37조7000억원을 뛰어넘는다. 반도체 부문 국내 임직원 기준 1인당 6억원에 육박한다.)

Behind President Lee's criticism—that "some organized workers are making unreasonable demands just to save themselves"—lies a rapidly deteriorating public sentiment. Initially, the presidential office had refrained from commenting on the Samsung Electronics union issue, stating it would not directly intervene in individual corporate labor-management disputes. (취임 이후 친노동 기조를 이어왔던 이 대통령이 “일부 조직 노동자들이 자신들만 살겠다고 부당한 요구를 한다”고 지적한 배경에는 급격히 악화된 국민 여론이 자리 잡고 있다. 당초 청와대는 삼성전자 노조 문제와 관련해, 개별 기업 노사 문제에는 직접 관여하지 않겠다며 말을 아껴왔다.)

If the Samsung Electronics union's demands are met, concerns that other corporate unions will follow with wage increase requests also weigh on the presidential office. President Lee remarked, "Last month, producer prices rose significantly. Typically, when producer prices surge, consumer prices are affected one or two months later, so we need to strengthen more proactive price stabilization measures." (삼성전자 노조의 요구가 관철될 경우 다른 기업 노조들의 임금 인상 요구가 이어질 거란 점도 청와대에는 부담이다. 이 대통령은 “지난달 생산자 물가가 크게 올랐는데, 통상 생산자 물가가 크게 오르면 한두 달 뒤에 장바구니 물가도 영향을 받기 때문에 더욱더 적극적인 물가 안정 대책을 강화해야 한다”고 했다.)

Meanwhile, President Lee plans to invite major labor umbrella organizations, including the two largest labor federations, to the presidential office's State Guesthouse for the "2026 Labor Day Commemorative Ceremony" on the 1st. President Lee said, "Starting this year, Labor Day has not only reclaimed its rightful name but has also been designated as a legal public holiday, making its significance very special." Last November, a bill to change 'Workers' Day' to 'Labor Day' passed the National Assembly, and in March, a bill designating Labor Day as a public holiday was also enacted. (한편 이 대통령은 1일 양대 노총 등을 청와대 영빈관으로 초청해 ‘2026 노동절 기념식’을 열 예정이다. 이 대통령은 “올해부터 노동절이 노동이라는 정당한 이름을 되찾았을 뿐만 아니라 법정 공휴일로 지정돼 그 의미가 매우 각별하다”고 했다. 지난해 11월 ‘근로자의 날’을 ‘노동절’로 변경하는 법안이 국회를 통과했고, 지난 3월엔 노동절을 공휴일로 지정하는 법안도 처리됐다.)

item.title: Special Counsel with Power to Drop Charges against Lee to Be Appointed by Lee (李 공소취소권 가진 특검, 李가 임명)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea, about a month ahead of the June 3 local elections, proposed a special counsel bill on the 30th that grants the special counsel the authority to drop charges in cases where President Lee Jae-myung is the defendant, targeting what it calls "fabricated indictments." The power to appoint the special counsel lies with the president, and the president also approves the special counsel bill. The People Power Party criticized it, saying, "President Lee is moving to erase his own crimes with a special counsel he appoints," calling it "a malicious law that completely collapses the criminal justice system for a self-pardon." Notably, this special counsel bill was spearheaded by Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Geon-tae, who was a lawyer for President Lee in the Daejang-dong case. The Supreme Prosecutors' Office expressed concerns on the same day, stating, "The bill has the potential to unduly influence judicial independence." <<> The scope of the special counsel investigation includes not only the seven cases previously covered by the National Assembly's parliamentary inquiry led by the Democratic Party into alleged "fabricated indictments by the Yoon Seok-youl regime's political prosecutors," such as the Daejang-dong and Wirye New Town development corruption cases and the Ssangbangwool remittance to North Korea case, but also five additional cases involving President Lee. These include the Public Official Election Act violation case that the Supreme Court remanded for a guilty verdict, the perjury solicitation case currently under appellate trial, and the Baekhyeon-dong development corruption, Seongnam FC bribery, and Gyeonggi Province corporate card misuse allegations, all at the first trial stage. Trials for these cases have all been halted since President Lee's election. <<> According to the special counsel bill, the special counsel would be forced to take over the authority to maintain the prosecution of ongoing cases involving President Lee and decide whether to continue prosecution. In particular, a clause stating "can also decide on whether to maintain the prosecution" gives the special counsel the power to drop charges. The bill also allows the special counsel to intervene in prosecution personnel matters, such as excluding prosecutors who refuse to transfer cases. <<> This special counsel would be the largest and longest-lasting in history. The investigative team would total 357 personnel, including 30 dispatched prosecutors, and the investigation period would extend up to 180 days, also the longest on record. Candidates for special counsel are recommended one each by the Democratic Party, the People Power Party, and the Rebuilding Korea Party, with the president appointing one among them. The Democratic Party plans to process the special counsel bill at a National Assembly plenary session as early as early May. (더불어민주당이 6·3 지방선거를 한 달여 앞둔 30일 이재명 대통령이 피고인인 사건에 대한 공소 취소 권한을 특검에게 부여하는 ‘조작 기소’ 특검법안을 발의했다. 특검 임명권은 대통령에게 있고, 특검법 재가도 대통령이 한다. 국민의힘은 “이 대통령이 자신이 임명하는 특검으로 자기 죄 지우기에 나선 것”이라며 “셀프 면죄부를 위해 형사사법시스템을 완전히 붕괴시킨 악법”이라고 비판했다. 특히 이번 특검법안은 이 대통령 관련 대장동 사건의 변호인이었던 민주당 이건태 의원 등이 주도했다. 대검찰청은 이날 특검법안에 대해 “재판의 독립성에 부당한 영향을 끼칠 가능성이 있다”며 우려를 표했다.)
